entities.summary: Ana Maria Pessoa Pereira da Silva Pinto is an East Timorese politician who served in several roles, including as the country's prosecutor general. She is a member of FRETILIN. Ana Pessoa Pinto was a jurists & legal scholars from Bobonaro (b. 1956-01-05, Bobonaro). Its legacy: Advanced jurisprudential scholarship and legal theory.
